country_event = {
	id = krcw_world.2
	title = krcw_world.2.t
	desc = krcw_world.2.d
	picture = GFX_krcw_conference
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.2.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 70
		}
		every_country = { limit = { krcw_is_ti = yes } add_ideas = krcw_paris_clearing_union }
		set_global_flag = KRCW_paris_clearing_union
		random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.3 days = 0 } }
		krcw_detente_up_small = yes
		add_political_power = 50
		set_global_flag = KRCW_pcu_open
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.2.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 30
		}
		every_country = { limit = { krcw_is_ti = yes } add_ideas = krcw_paris_clearing_union }
		set_global_flag = KRCW_paris_clearing_union

	}
}

# krcw_world.10
country_event = {
	id = krcw_world.10
	title = krcw_world.10.t
	desc = krcw_world.10.d
	picture = GFX_krcw_wilhelm_c
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		DDR = { exists = yes }
		WGR = { exists = yes }
		FRA = { exists = yes }
		WGR = { owns_state = 742 }
		NOT = { has_war_with = WGR }
		NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_berlin_crisis_over }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.10.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
		set_global_flag = KRCW_berlin_blockade
		krcw_tension_up_medium = yes
		add_political_power = 50
		set_variable = { global.krcw_berlin_pressure = 50 }
		FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.11 days = 3 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.10.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 20 krcw_route_random = yes }
			modifier = { add = 20 krcw_route_free = yes }
		}
		krcw_tension_up_small = yes
		set_global_flag = KRCW_berlin_crisis_over
		random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.18 days = 2 } }
	}
}

country_event = {
	id = krcw_world.11
	title = krcw_world.11.t
	desc = krcw_world.11.d
	picture = GFX_krcw_hungry_people
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.11.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
		}
		set_global_flag = KRCW_berlin_airlift
		add_political_power = -50
		random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.12 days = 5 } }
		DDR = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.14 days = 40 random_days = 20 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.11.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 10 krcw_route_random = yes }
			modifier = { add = 3 krcw_route_free = yes }
			modifier = { add = 5 check_variable = { global.krcw_tension > 80 } }
			modifier = { add = 15 check_variable = { global.krcw_tension > 90 } }
		}
		krcw_tension_up_large = yes
		add_war_support = 0.05
		SOV = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.13 days = 3 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.11.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 5 krcw_route_random = yes }
		}
		clr_global_flag = KRCW_berlin_blockade
		set_global_flag = KRCW_berlin_crisis_over
		krcw_tension_down_medium = yes
		krcw_detente_up_small = yes
		if = { limit = { WGR = { exists = yes } } WGR = { add_stability = 0.05 add_war_support = 0.03 } }
		add_political_power = -75
		WGR = { add_stability = -0.08 }
		random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.18 days = 2 } }
	}
}

# krcw_world.40
country_event = {
	id = krcw_world.40
	hidden = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_sputnik_1871 }
		NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_sov_satellite_first }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.40.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				SOV = { exists = yes has_country_flag = krcw_sov_space_race }
				OR = { krcw_route_free = yes AND = { krcw_route_random = yes FRA = { NOT = { has_country_flag = krcw_fra_space_race } } } }
			}
			SOV = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.42 days = 1 } }
		}
		else = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.41 days = 1 } }
	}
}

			limit = {

				has_global_flag = KRCW_sov_nuke
				USA = { exists = yes is_in_faction_with = SOV }
				FRA = { exists = yes }
				NOT = { has_war_with = FRA }
			}
			country_event = { id = krcw_world.50 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_great_lakes_crisis_over } }
			set_global_flag = KRCW_great_lakes_crisis_over
			set_global_flag = KRCW_glc_averted
			FRA = { country_event = { id = krcw_world.59 days = 54 random_days = 30 } }
		}
	}
}

	id = krcw_world.62
	title = krcw_world.62.t
	desc = krcw_world.62.d
	picture = GFX_krcw_happy_crowd_n
	major = yes
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.62.a
		trigger = {
			krcw_is_ti = yes
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.62.b
		trigger = {
			krcw_is_ma = yes
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.62.c
		trigger = {
			NOT = { krcw_is_ti = yes }
			NOT = { krcw_is_ma = yes }
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
	}
}

	is_triggered_only = yes

		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
		}
		add_stability = 0.02
	}
}

# krcw_world.81
country_event = {
	id = krcw_world.81
	title = krcw_world.81.t
	desc = krcw_world.81.d
	picture = GFX_krcw_naval_battle
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_psa_aligned }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.81.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_aligned
		set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_ti
		krcw_tension_up_small = yes
		if = { limit = { WCA = { exists = yes } } WCA = { puppet = PSA } }
		else_if = { limit = { FRA = { exists = yes } } FRA = { add_to_faction = PSA } }
		random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.83 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.81.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_aligned
		set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_ti
		krcw_tension_up_small = yes
		if = { limit = { FRA = { exists = yes } } FRA = { add_to_faction = PSA } }
		random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.83 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.81.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ti = 50 }
		add_stability = -0.05
	}
}

# krcw_world.82
country_event = {
	id = krcw_world.82
	title = krcw_world.82.t
	desc = krcw_world.82.d
	picture = GFX_krcw_huey_long
	is_triggered_only = yes
	trigger = {
		NOT = { has_global_flag = KRCW_psa_aligned }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.82.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_aligned
		set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_ma
		krcw_tension_up_small = yes
		if = { limit = { USA = { exists = yes } } USA = { puppet = PSA } }
		else_if = { limit = { SOV = { exists = yes } } SOV = { add_to_faction = PSA } }
		random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.83 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.82.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 50
		}
		set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_aligned
		set_global_flag = KRCW_psa_ma
		krcw_tension_up_small = yes
		if = { limit = { SOV = { exists = yes } } SOV = { add_to_faction = PSA } }
		random_country = { news_event = { id = krcw_world.83 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.82.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
		}
		subtract_from_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ma = 50 }
		add_stability = -0.05
	}
}

# krcw_world.85
country_event = {
	id = krcw_world.85
	title = krcw_world.85.t
	desc = krcw_world.85.d
	picture = GFX_krcw_huey_long
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.85.a
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 40 krcw_route_random = yes }
			modifier = { add = 20 krcw_route_free = yes }
		}
		add_to_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ma = 20 }
		clamp_variable = { var = krcw_psa_lean_ti min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { var = krcw_psa_lean_ma min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.85.b
		ai_chance = {
			base = 0
			modifier = { add = 35 krcw_route_random = yes }
			modifier = { add = 20 krcw_route_free = yes }
		}
		add_to_variable = { krcw_psa_lean_ti = 20 }
		clamp_variable = { var = krcw_psa_lean_ti min = 0 max = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { var = krcw_psa_lean_ma min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
	option = {
		name = krcw_world.85.c
		ai_chance = {
			base = 100
			modifier = { factor = 0.3 krcw_route_random = yes }
			modifier = { factor = 0.6 krcw_route_free = yes }
		}
		add_stability = 0.03
	}
}
